messages:
maya: Heads up — we need a lightweight playbook for next week's webinar: clear competitive soundbites vs Cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Also need inbound lead routing rules that sales/ops can actually follow. Can folks drop quick takes here by EOD? :wave:
aj: Quick thought — primary win vs cloud AI platforms = predictable latency + rollout controls. One-liner: 'Ship with confidence — consistent latency and cost predictability across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.' Thoughts? :thinking_face:
leo: Love the latency + cost predictability hook. For LLM APIs angle, emphasize unified runtime & observability: "same interface across environments + token-level cost visibility." Keeps it actionable for platform teams.
caroline: For infra vendors, call out dev velocity + ops burden: "skip the homegrown stack — get production-grade batching, caching, and fallback policies out of the box." Add a short customer example for credibility (no PII).
sam: Routing rules (first draft) — suggest this simple set that ops can implement in Outreach/CRM: ```
# inbound routing pseudo
if lead.source == 'webinar' and lead.account_tier in ['mid','enterprise']:
  route -> AE_team
elif lead.intent_score >= 90:
  route -> Solutions_SE
elif lead.job_role in ['platform','ml_eng']:
  route -> Platform_BDRs
else:
  route -> Marketing_Nurture
```
maya: @sam perfect. Can we add a fallback rule to send any high-usage trial account (trial_tokens > 1e6) to AE regardless of role? That catches committed prospects.
sam: added to doc — will push to shared routing rules doc and tag ops.
leo: Messaging micro-tests: 1) Latency & cost predictability (A) 2) Unified runtime + observability (B) 3) Ops burden avoided + rollout controls (C). We should A/B these in the webinar follow-up sequence (short subject lines and one-sentence lead).
caroline: I drafted three 1-liners for the follow-up email (dropbox):
- A: "Predictable latency, predictable price — keep SLAs without guessing costs."
- B: "One runtime, every environment — ship features faster with the same API."
- C: "Ditch brittle infra — production batching, KV caching, and seamless fallbacks."
Please vote. :ballot_box_with_check:
aj: My vote B then A. B resonates with Platform/Dev leads.
maya: Votes noted. @caroline can you finalize copy and short bullets for the webinar slide that map to each soundbite? Also add the benchmark callout: 2x lower tail latency vs default cloud endpoints in our internal test (link in docs).
caroline: On it — I'll link the benchmark sheet. Quick ask: can Eng provide the short benchmark stat with exact test name so we can be precise? @leo any chance you can get that?
leo: Yep — I'll pull the microbenchmark results and DM the exact phrase. Expecting "~50% reduction in P95 for long chat workloads vs generic managed endpoints" but will confirm.
ops-bot: Routing rules doc updated: https://drive.redwood/repo/marketing/inbound-routing-v3 (ops notified) :white_check_mark:
maya: This is great. Final deliverables: 1) one-pager playbook (soundbites + follow-up email variations), 2) routing rules pushed to CRM, 3) benchmark phrasing from Eng, 4) webinar slide bullets. Owners: caroline (1,4), sam (2), leo (3). Deadline: tomorrow noon PT. Thanks team! :rocket:
